case_title.reason: Case title matches the caption on page 1.

number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants; judgment says the prosecutrix was raped by two persons.

accused_gender.reason: Accused are described as having raped the female prosecutrix, implying male perpetrators; no explicit gender is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: she was waylaid by the appellants who carried her to a nearby field
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment never describes any relationship; 'Stranger' is an inference not stated.

offence_category.reason: Offence is rape (gang rape under s.376(2)(g)).

evidence_type.quote: The High Court has relied on the evidence of PW.1 and her parents as also on some part of the evidence of Dr. Mamta Sthapak-PW.7
evidence_type.reason: Main evidence is direct oral testimony plus medical; 'circumstantial' is not supported.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are separately identified beyond the gang rape charge.

trial_court_outcome.quote: On a cumulative assessment of the prosecution evidence the Trial Court acquitted the accused.

high_court_outcome.quote: sentenced the accused to 10 years R.I. with a fine of Rs.25,000/- under Section 376(2)(g) of the IPC
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court convicted and sentenced as stated.

final_outcome.quote: the conviction of the appellants is set aside and they are acquitted.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction was set aside, so no offence was finally established.

imprisonment_type.reason: No final imprisonment; conviction set aside.

imprisonment_years.reason: No final imprisonment term applies after acquittal.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine applies after acquittal; the Rs.25,000 fine was the set-aside High Court order.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts as stated, omitting the final outcome (High Court reversal and Supreme Court acquittal).
neutral_facts.quote: but the Supreme Court ultimately set aside the High Court's conviction and acquitted the accused.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but the summary reveals the court outcome, which neutral_facts must not do.

offence_severity.quote: sentenced the accused to 10 years R.I.
offence_severity.reason: Judgment gives no minimum or maximum sentencing range; only the 10-year sentence imposed by the High Court.

attempt_completion.reason: Judgment states the prosecutrix was raped, indicating a completed offence.

physical_harm.quote: no injury had been found on her person
physical_harm.reason: Medical evidence found no injury; no evidence of rape.

number_of_offences.quote: the conviction of the appellants is set aside and they are acquitted.
number_of_offences.reason: Only one charge was framed, but the conviction was set aside, so none was upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is mentioned; 'Not applicable' conveys this.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Court accepted the medical evidence showing no injury and no evidence of rape; it found the delay explanation unbelievable.
key_evidence_accepted.quote: We find that the explanation for this delay is somewhat difficult to believe.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court rejected the delay explanation rather than accepting it; the accepted evidence was the medical report.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Trial court found the prosecutrix's statement full of contradictions and her parents' evidence based on her information; the Supreme Court did not expressly declare witnesses unreliable.
witness_credibility.quote: the statement of the prosecutrix was full of contradictions and as the statements of her father and mother (PW2 and PW.3) were based on the information given by her to them, no reliance could be placed
witness_credibility.reason: Contradictions and unreliability findings were the trial court's; the Supreme Court only held the trial court's view possible.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct is addressed beyond the delayed FIR, not characterized as conduct.

bail_history.quote: The appellants are on bail; their bail bonds shall stand discharged.
bail_history.reason: Judgment states the appellants were on bail and bonds discharged.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date, trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court dates match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: On the completion of the investigation the accused were charged
investigation_status.reason: Investigation completed, charges framed and trial held; the facts are supported.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Listed points match the judgment's findings on delay, medical examination location and medical report.

appeal_history.reason: Trial acquittal, High Court conviction and Supreme Court acquittal match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.quote: The High Court has given a finding that the decision of the Trial Court was perverse and called for interference.
prosecution_argument.reason: Judgment does not record prosecution arguments; the entry mixes in the High Court's reasoning.

defence_argument.reason: Judgment does not record any defence arguments.

legal_principle_applied.quote: if the view taken by the Trial Court was possible on the evidence, the High Court should stay its hands
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the Court's stated principle on interference with acquittal.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing rationale applies since conviction was set aside.

other_sentence_order.reason: Only bail bonds discharged is ordered; no other sentence order exists.
